name: minion
description: Operate Minion (github.com/patrick-1984/ai-minion) from Codex: detect an installed minion or install it, start and pair a Worker with a Hub, list, read and type into terminal sessions, and act as a Minion master once an administrator grants it. The skill is the same guide as "minion llm-help".

interface.shortDescription: Operate terminal sessions on many machines
defaultPrompt: is minion installed here, and is this machine paired with a Hub?
list my minion sessions and show the screen of build
set this machine up as a minion Worker
